reviewer: Seed-0 witness review (ora qualify robolab contract-witness)
scope: robolab MoveBananaToBagelPlateTask at the pinned revision; generated per predicate family (on_surface); seed-0 witness pending. Semantic projection of the official termination, not physical qualification.
task_language: Move the bananas to the bagel plate

predicate_and_helpers.basis: Read MoveBananaToBagelPlateTask terminations: success = object_on_top(object=['banana', 'banana_01'], reference_object='plate_small', logical='all', require_gripper_detached=True), and the helpers in conditionals.py and predicate_logic.py; RobolabEnv records success as the TerminationManager's terminated flag, the OR of every non-timeout term.

reset_and_randomization.basis: Scene breakfast_table.usda: banana, banana_01, plate_small among 20 contact objects. The env's only event is reset_scene_to_default and the task adds none, so every seed resets to the same authored layout; a seed varies physics only.

assets_and_frames.basis: Support is the contact force from the surface on the object (upward, inside the support cone) plus the object's box centroid inside the surface's world-AABB footprint; height is not bounded.

success_timing.basis: DoneTerm success is evaluated every control step; RobolabEnv freezes the env at the first true step (a termination within its first two steps is reset as a physics artifact) and the ORA session latches it.

public_observability.basis: At reset every named object (3) projects into the over-shoulder or wrist camera with a depth reading that does not hide it (witness sha256 530046b0040c).

success_witness.basis: Witness (seed 0, sha256 530046b0040c): all_on -> True; each case from a fresh reset, objects placed by direct state edits with the robot held.

counterexamples.basis: Witness (seed 0, sha256 530046b0040c): reset_state -> False; beside -> False.

no_expert_strategy.basis: Clauses state end conditions only; no approach, grasp, route or motion advice.

privacy.basis: No coordinates, thresholds, fixture or object identifiers, joint values or predicate names enter the public text; numeric limits stay in this private record.

conditions.source_basis: success = object_on_top(object=['banana', 'banana_01'], reference_object='plate_small', logical='all', require_gripper_detached=True): is_supported_on_surface (contact force from the surface above 0.1 N, upward, within 45 degrees of vertical) and centroid_in_footprint (box centroid xy inside the surface's world AABB).
conditions.interpretation: Supported by the bagel plate, centered over it.

conditions.source_basis: require_gripper_detached=True: gripper_detached checks that no gripper body touches the object above 0.1 N.
conditions.interpretation: Release: the gripper touches none of the named objects.
Support force bar, support cone and footprint slack withheld.

public_clauses: Both bananas must end up resting on the bagel plate, each supported by the bagel plate itself with its center over it.
Let go of each of them: the task is not complete while the gripper still touches either one.

counterexamples.case: Objects in place while one is still gripped: false by gripper_detached (source-derived, not executed).

notes.detail: official limit 1350 native actions (90 s at 15 Hz; 4050 under the default extended budget), against 900 for the longest task admitted before

witness_plan.note: each case starts from a fresh reset of seed 0; the robot holds its reset pose with the gripper open unless a case grasps; success is any official result over the case's ticks

limitations: Generated from the pinned source; the witness (phase B) covers seed 0 only and uses direct state edits or scripted moves, never a policy rollout. Source-derived negative cases marked as such are not executed.
